meta.title: AuraCell 4D — scripted monitoring scenario (DESIGN MODE B, SIMULATION)
meta.note: Every value here is scripted to illustrate the decision table of writeup Section 3.3. No hardware, no real recording.
meta.note_imaging: In the demo 1 s of wall-clock = 1 min of experiment; frames every 9.5 s represent the 9.5-min CTC cadence.

events.msg: Perfusion started: 10 µL/min → τ = 6µQ/(w·h²) = 1.00 dyn/cm² (CONTINUE band 0.5–15)
Acoustic channel: continuous, 250 kS/s, watching 80–180 kHz (Minnaert band). Imaging: periodic z-stack every 9.5 min.
Acoustic burst 109.6 kHz (6.2 σ) → Minnaert radius ≈ 30 µm bubble at inlet
FLAG: timestamp T logged; extra z-stack requested within 60 s
Event-triggered snapshot acquired (T + 2 min)
Tracker: tracks 3 and 10 end within ±1 frame of T without a division
→ marked MECHANICAL-ARTEFACT CANDIDATES; excluded from drug-death count (reason attached)
COUNTERFACTUAL: a tracker without the acoustic channel would count tracks 3 and 10 as drug deaths (naive count 2 vs AuraCell 0)
Transient at 62 kHz (4.4 σ) — pump harmonic, OUTSIDE the 80–180 kHz Minnaert band → logged, no flag, no exclusion
ΔP rising: 1.2× baseline (watch)
ΔP 1.7× baseline (≈ 50 % occlusion ≙ 2.3×)
FLAG: pressure drop 1.5–2.5× baseline → operator notified, snapshot requested
ΔP 2.6× baseline and rising > 20 %/min
STOP RECOMMENDED: membrane risk. Software does not control the pump — operator decides.
Operator reduced flow to 4 µL/min → τ = 0.40 dyn/cm²; ΔP relaxing
ΔP back to 1.3× baseline → CONTINUE
State: CONTINUE (flag history kept in audit log)
ILP: division 5 → (11, 12), gate penalty 0.00 → PASS
ILP: division 2 → (13, 14) chosen despite gate penalty 0.42 (daughter ratio 1.6) → FLAG FOR REVIEW
FLAG: division shown to researcher with both daughter volumes
Track 7 ends; no acoustic/pressure event within ±1 frame → counted as drug-associated death
COUNTERFACTUAL: naive drug-death count would now read 3; AuraCell reads 1 (+2 excluded with reasons attached)
Acoustic burst 142 kHz (4.1 σ) ≈ 23 µm bubble
FLAG: 2nd burst in 10 min (notice at ≥ 3); snapshot requested
No track ended near this event → nothing excluded

Audit export: 10 tracks, 2 divisions (1 PASS, 1 FLAG), 2 artefact candidates excluded, 1 drug-associated death (naive count would be 3), 1 out-of-band transient ignored, 4 FLAG + 1 STOP recommendation
Researcher review → next dose → loop back to perfusion
